name: cfa-agent
description: CFA Agent marketplace — institutional financial-analysis plugins for Claude Code. cfa-core (offline compute, no API keys), cfa-data (free public data feeds), cfa-pro (FMP + paid vendor data).

plugins.name: cfa-core
plugins.description: Institutional-grade corporate finance toolkit — 227 WASM-backed compute tools, 21 CFA-aligned skills, 57 slash commands, 9 specialist research agents. 100% offline / decimal-precision math / no API keys required.

plugins.name: cfa-data
plugins.description: Free / freemium public data feeds — FRED, EDGAR, FIGI, Yahoo Finance, World Bank, plus geopolitical sources (ACLED, GDELT, GDACS, NASA, EIA, WTO, etc.). 129 MCP tools.

plugins.name: cfa-pro
plugins.description: Premium market-data plugin — Financial Modeling Prep (180 tools, freemium, requires FMP_API_KEY) plus paid vendor MCPs covering LSEG, S&P Global, FactSet, Morningstar, Moody's, PitchBook (87 tools).
